answer.summary: The Docker build failed in the front-end Vite build, not from infrastructure. Graph.tsx has a JSX syntax error (unclosed Box tag near line 290), and Graph.tsx is one of the files this change touched. The error is deterministic and will repeat on re-run.

evidence.quote: #28 25.79 [builtin:vite-transform] Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for 'Box'.

#28 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c set -eux                             ; npm install -g corepack                  ; yarn install                             ; yarn build                               ;" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
